flags.question: Find all movies that have been produced by persons born after 1960 limited to top 5.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie)
WHERE p.born > 1960
RETURN m
LIMIT 5
details: Question asks for top-5 but TypeQL has no sort

flags.question: List the top 5 movies that have not been reviewed.

WHERE NOT EXISTS { (m)<-[:REVIEWED]-() }
RETURN m.title
LIMIT 5

flags.question: Who are the actors in the movie with the highest number of votes?
flags.cypher:
MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(p:Person)
WHERE m.votes IS NOT NULL
WITH m, p
ORDER BY m.votes DESC
LIMIT 1
RETURN m.title AS movie, collect(p.name) AS actors
details: Cypher has ORDER BY (before final RETURN) but TypeQL has no sort
Cypher has LIMIT 1 but TypeQL has no limit

flags.question: Which movies released between 2005 and 2010 have the tagline 'Speed has no limits'?

MATCH (m:Movie)
WHERE m.released >= 2005 AND m.released <= 2010
  AND m.tagline = 'Speed has no limits'
RETURN m.title

flags.question: Who has the most movies with a 'Silly, but fun' review summary?
flags.cypher:
MATCH (p:Person)-[:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie)
WHERE p.name IS NOT NULL
WITH p, count(CASE WHEN m.summary = 'Silly, but fun' THEN 1 END) AS silly_reviews
RETURN p.name AS name, silly_reviews
ORDER BY silly_reviews DESC
LIMIT 1
details: Cypher uses CASE WHEN but TypeQL may lack equivalent branching

flags.question: Name 3 people who have the most combined roles across all their ACTED_IN movies.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)
WITH p, size(r.roles) AS role_count
RETURN p.name, sum(role_count) AS total_roles
ORDER BY total_roles DESC
LIMIT 3
details: Cypher uses SUM() but TypeQL has no sum()

flags.question: Show top 3 persons who directed, produced, and acted in the same movie.

MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)<-[:PRODUCED]-(p)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m)
RETURN p.name AS person, m.title AS movie
LIMIT 3
